---
title: Using DASCore with Docker
execute:
  warning: false
---

Build an image of DASCore's stable conda-forge release with the repository's [Docker](https://www.docker.com/) file:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/DASDAE/dascore
```

```bash
cd dascore
docker build -t dascore .
```

Mount the current directory and run a script from it:

```bash
docker run -it -v $PWD:/app dascore python /app/test.py
```
